card.name: Photoshop tutorial text and scattered punctuation
card.fires_on: Mostly punctuation, digits and small linking words inside Photoshop or design tutorial write-ups, such as a size like 512px, a dash after 'Photoshop CS', or 'we will be creating'. It also fires on scattered words in religious passages.

modes.label: Photoshop tutorial details

card.writes: It leans toward the word tutorial and similar teaching words, so it pushes the text toward tutorial content.
card.plain: It lights up on small bits of text in Photoshop how-to pages, and sometimes on scripture, with no single word that stands out.
